verdict.rationale: The docs show some per-item control over physical mail: you can ask that an item not be opened or scanned and have it shipped to you instead ("You decide the best way to handle your mail"). Automation rules and forwarding are also mentioned. Nothing in the pack covers shredding, storage windows or disposal confirmations. Missing for 10: documented physical-storage windows/retention periods, on-request shredding, shred confirmation, an explicit per-item disposal menu (shred/recycle/store), and independent corroboration.
